shared_elements: incised linear detail on a worn surface
repeated paired forms arranged roughly symmetrically (horses in A, bird-like forms in B)
justification: Both are stone surfaces bearing shallow relief with figural motifs and discrete disc/circle elements, and both show paired, mirrored forms, but that is about as far as it goes. A is a flat horizontal narrative frieze read left-to-right with modelled naturalistic bodies, horses and a chariot; B is a rounded three-dimensional monolith whose back carries flat, schematic, vertically stacked emblems, so the format, viewing conditions and carving manner differ completely.
